Commitments of Traders — Dashboard Barchart data

Data retrieved from barchart.com: Commitments of Traders positions (the CFTC's Legacy futures-only report, released Fridays 15:30 US Eastern) and weekly prices of the nearest futures contract, for every product on barchart's Commitments of Traders page, grouped under barchart's own categories. All products use the Legacy report's trader groups (Commercial, Non-Commercial, Non-Reportable), including those barchart charts from the Disaggregated or TFF reports. Barchart publishes long/short breakdowns for roughly the latest year only, so the Long Ratio charts start there and gain a week with every update; net positions, the Composite Index and Stochastics run back to 2000 or to the contract's first report. Non-Commercial = large speculators, Commercial = hedgers, Non-Reportable = small traders. Net position = long − short. Percentile ranks and Stochastic %K are computed as described on each chart.

Provided for information only. This is not investment advice, and no warranty is given as to the accuracy or completeness of the figures shown.
